alt.en: A blue cube of model weights stands at the center of a gray floor. A dashed orange line with packets runs from a gray document at the front left, beside a yellow warning sign, and breaks off before it reaches the cube. A dotted gray line joins the cube to a teal glass agent at the right, and a violet bar chart with falling bars stands behind on the left.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一个蓝色的模型权重方块。前方左侧的灰色文档旁有一块黄色警告牌，一条带数据包的橙色虚线从文档出发，在到达方块前断开。一条灰色点线把方块连向右侧的青色玻璃智能体，左后方立着一组逐级下降的紫色柱状图。

caption.en: Illustration: an injected instruction from an untrusted document breaks off before a defended model that drives an agent, with a bar chart standing for the authors' reported attack rates. It does not depict the SecPO model, its benchmarks or a tested deployment, and it does not show that the defense works as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：来自不可信文档的注入指令在到达驱动智能体的防御模型前断开，柱状图代表作者报告的攻击成功率。图中并非 SecPO 模型、其基准或任何经过测试的部署，也不表明该防御如所述有效。
